heading: A grid that breaks the grid
subtext: Spanning cards, asymmetric layouts, and visual hierarchy that guides the eye naturally.

items.title: Config-driven hierarchy
items.description: Each card declares its span and position, so every layout tells a story.

items.title: Mobile-first bento
items.description: Cards stack vertically on small screens, expand into position on desktop. No breakage.

items.title: Rich media support
items.description: Embed images, gradients, or accent colors per card. Every tile has its own personality.

items.title: Zero JS overhead
items.description: Pure CSS Grid with named template areas. No JavaScript, no layout shift, no CLS penalty.
